acceptanceCriteria: Detection requires rspec / rspec-rails in Gemfile or Gemfile.lock (bounded read of the committed blob); a Minitest fixture with spec/ gets no rspec command and keeps the unknown line
Minitest repos optionally get bundle exec rake test or bin/rails test when detectable, else the unknown line
body: PR #1134 offers bundle exec rspec when the index tracks a root Gemfile and a root .rspec or any spec/ path, without checking that the Gemfile (or Gemfile.lock) depends on rspec. A Minitest-only repo with a spec/ directory (minitest/spec style) is told to run rspec, which fails. Recorded as a failure mode in both requirements. Suspected impact; not observed on a real repo yet.
title: Ruby verification detects RSpec from spec/ or .rspec without reading the Gemfile: a Minitest repo is told bundle exec rspec (NGI-V0-027 / AFP-V0-066 failure mode)
